tb21_profile.skill: Obtain a legacy C source release and make it compile and install under a modern toolchain: fix Makefiles/configure, resolve headers and libs, install a working binary to a prefix
tb21_profile.domain: Unix C build toolchain (make/autotools/gcc), vendored third-party source tarballs, /usr/local install prefixes
tb21_profile.task_form: build/packaging from source: download, extract, repair the build, compile, install, then prove the binary runs

searches: tools.py words rebench setuptools build_ext cmake wheel install prefix source distribution

TMax-15K.reason: Vendored jq-1.6 tree whose ./configure && make is deliberately broken; must diagnose the build regression and produce a working binary.
Fix typo in datamash-1.8 Makefile.in, then ./configure --prefix=/usr/local, make, make install - same repair-then-install-a-C-package loop.
fping-5.1 autotools build broken (bad Makefile.am, non-executable configure); needs autoreconf -i, configure, make to a working binary.
Download FFTW 3.3.10 tarball, extract, compile, install to a prefix, then link against it - same fetch/extract/build/install chain.
Configure, build and install zlib to a custom prefix after fixing what is missing from the library build.
libseccomp-2.5.4 configure script/Makefile carries an injected flaw; find it and get the C library to build.
Syntax error in jo-1.9 Makefile.in must be found before ./configure && make yields the binary; same autotools debugging.
Vendored C extension fails to build offline; must read compiler errors and patch the C source to make it compile.
Repair a sabotaged configure script, then ./configure --prefix && make && make install - the install-to-prefix half of POV-Ray.
Download, configure and compile aubio from upstream source before using it; same obtain-and-build-a-C-library step.

Recursive-Task-Synthesis.reason: Download the PostgreSQL 16.2 source tarball from a URL, build it and install to a named prefix - structurally the same job.
Same build-PostgreSQL-from-tarball-to-prefix task; exercises configure/make/make install on a large C codebase.
Build Janus 0.10.5 plus its whole chain of C library dependencies from source in order - dependency-resolution-by-building.
Compile Janus and all required C libraries from source into /opt/janus; same prefix-install and missing-dependency debugging.
Build rar from local source, install to /usr/local/bin/rar, then run it on a real file - identical prove-the-binary-works ending.
Install from source on CentOS 7 with missing build dependencies; must fetch and verify the source archive first.
Build sclite from the old SCTK C toolkit, picking a stable release out of git history - legacy source, awkward build.
No extractor available: must read instructions for the download location, build the tool from source, then use it.
Local source archive plus checksum manifest; verify, unpack and build on an old CentOS 7 userland.
Resolve missing Python 3 and build tools on CentOS 7, download the source, then build and install it.

TerminalWorld-Seeds-Clean.reason: Download the st 0.4.1 tarball from a URL, build an old suckless C program, install system-wide - almost the same task with a different program.
Build VIM from source with a large configure feature set and install to /usr prefix; heavy build-dependency hunting.
Install a pinned nginx version from source and show it starts cleanly - build, install, then sanity-run the binary.
Local v4.2.0.tar.gz of a C library built and installed system-wide on old CentOS 7 - extract, build, install exactly as here.
Resurrect EOL Python 2 software on Debian Buster with archive mirrors; same fight against a dead-toolchain-era package.
Check out a tagged PgBouncer source, apply the pgbouncer-rr patch, configure and build to an installed binary.
Must identify and install the unlisted build dependencies of a C++ Qt project before it will compile from source.
Prepare the build environment and compile a project from source until all build artifacts exist; no install step.
Build with a specific older compiler (GCC 8 via devtoolset) and submodules - same compiler-version wrangling POV-Ray 2.2 needs.
Clone, build and install a C++ library plus its binaries system-wide; ordinary CMake build rather than a broken legacy one.

SWE-Smith-Seeds-Clean.reason: AutotoolsToolchain mishandles compiler flags - exactly the configure/CFLAGS machinery you must reason about to build POV-Ray.
GnuToolchain compiler variable resolution bug; teaches how CC/CXX/flags reach an autotools build.
Generated CMake and pkg-config files link the wrong library; same native link-resolution reasoning.
C++ standard flags differ between Clang and GCC - reasoning about which compiler accepts which flag.
Incorrect C++ standard flags for Clang; narrow flag-table fix but still native-toolchain territory.
Backup-sources download/upload in a C/C++ package manager - the obtain-the-source-archive half, in Python.
VirtualBuildEnv deactivation scripts: build-environment variable management around a native build.
CMakeDeps emits the wrong configuration in a build context; build-graph configuration debugging only.
Generated C source and its fuzzer Makefile get wrong paths - makefile path plumbing, but a Python unit fix.
Parallel jobs in CMake build presets; touches how a native build is actually invoked, nothing about broken sources.

SWE-Rebench-Tasks-Clean.reason: CMake build-backend configuration handling; closest thing here to reasoning about a native build's settings.
build_meta omits setup.py from the sdist - packaging/build-artifact correctness, though pure Python.
Rename cmake.* build options with deprecation; build-configuration surface of a CMake-driven packager.
Wheel ABI tag wrong for a debug Python build - artifact naming tied to how the interpreter was compiled.
Binding built against a specific HDF5 C library version; requires reasoning across the Python/C library boundary.
cffi-backed package whose behaviour depends on the compiled native layer and its build-time versions.
setup.py develop fails installing a script - the install-step-writes-an-executable concern, in Python packaging.
Install-time filesystem error in setuptools; only the install phase overlaps with the TB2.1 task.
Package/environment installation interaction; dependency provisioning, but no compilation at all.
Better error message when a build input file is missing - build tooling by name only; little transfer.

final_top10.reason: Download an old program's source tarball from a URL, compile it and install it system-wide - the same task with a different program.
Vendored jq-1.6 whose ./configure && make is sabotaged; diagnose the build failure until the binary works.
Fetch the PostgreSQL source tarball from a URL, build it and install it to a specified prefix.
Repair datamash-1.8 Makefile.in, then configure --prefix=/usr/local, make and make install a correctly named binary.
Build VIM from source with many optional features and install to a prefix; teaches configure-flag and dependency hunting.
Broken autotools tree: fix Makefile.am and configure permissions, run autoreconf -i, configure and make to a binary.
Get EOL Python 2 era software running again on an archived distro - same legacy-software-on-modern-host fight.
Build a tool from local source, install it to /usr/local/bin, then exercise the installed binary on real input.
Download an upstream C library tarball, extract, compile and install to a prefix before anything else can be built.
Install a pinned version of a C server from source and demonstrate the installed binary starts and stops cleanly.

notes: SWE-Smith and SWE-Rebench have no from-source C build tasks at all; the best available are conan native-toolchain bugs and Python packaging/build-backend issues, hence overall<=3 there - these ten are filler with honest scores. TerminalWorld is unusually strong for this TB2.1 task (dozens of genuine build-from-source seeds); I kept only ten but tw_275968, tw_7921, tw_30439, tw_322195 are comparable. The retrieval shortlist for TMax was dominated by boilerplate 'make install to a non-root prefix' bash-package chores; almost every TMax pick above came from my own ./configure / tarball searches, not from the shortlist.
